about: Round pockets that receive a bought part. Each kind names the fit parameters its size comes from: "d" the pocket diameter, "depth" the pocket depth, "part_h" the height of the bought part. A blind hole whose deepest diameter is the value of "d" (within tol.d) and that is not deeper than depth_max_factor times "depth" is a pocket of that kind. fits.bought_part_pocket judges the tags of "d" and "depth"; print.z_layers judges the depth against "part_h" in whole layers. A new bought part with a round pocket is one more kind here and its parameters in the registry; both rules list those parameters in "params".
